outcome: five minute Apgar score below seven
mortality within six hours of delivery
cohort: Singleton spontaneous-onset breech births at 24-31 weeks gestational age without antenatal medical complications requiring caesarean delivery
finding: While conventional statistical models showed protective effects of caesarean delivery for very preterm breech infants, analyses using propensity scores and based on unit policies did not confirm statistically significant associations.
mod_finding: Point estimates indicated protective effects of caesarean delivery for very preterm breech infants in conventional statistical models.
